intro: Choose the exact OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs scenes where clip rotation should run. Normalized scene changes can start and stop playback automatically, while the imported Enable and Disable actions remain available for manual control.

sections.title: 1. Automatic scenes
sections.description: Paste each complete program-scene name exactly as the selected broadcast app shows it. Include emoji, icons, brackets, spaces, and punctuation.

sections.title: 2. Playback timing
sections.description: Choose the full pause between clips and the number of clips in one shuffle cycle. The short fade is included in the pause.

sections.title: 3. Clip length
sections.description: Keep clips within a useful duration range for BRB, starting, or ending scenes.

sections.title: 4. Audio
sections.description: Choose whether clips are muted and set their playback volume.

sections.title: 5. Optional smoother playback
sections.description: Prefetch the selected clip to a private, bounded loopback cache before playback.
sections.notice: Disabled by default. Only Twitch CDN HTTPS video is accepted. Files are capped at 50 MB each, 250 MB total, expire within 24 hours, and are removed automatically.

sections.title: 6. Review before enabling
sections.description: Confirm the required Streamer.bot actions and browser source.
sections.notice: Import the separate Random Clip Player Streamer.bot package, approve only its Get Clips and Get Clip Download actions, and add the hosted clips overlay to OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs. Relay Scene Changed from the app you use; normalized program-scene changes start and stop configured scenes automatically. Enable and Disable remain optional manual controls.
